3. Mr AKM Shafiqur Rahman, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner, has submitted that the voter list Ext. 3 having been finally published on 5-3-83 and the election having been held on 4-1-84 on the basis of the said voter list, the finding of the Courts below that the voter list was changed in Ward No, 2 is not sustainable and in support of his submission the learned Advocate for the petitioner has referred to the decision in the case of Ghulam Abbas vs The Additional Commissioner and Election Tribunal Khairpur Mirs and others, PLD 1965 Karachi, 625 wherein it has been held as follows:— 

 4. in the present case on consideration of the evidence of PW 1, OPW 2 and OPWS. the Courts below have found correctly that the voter list was most illegally changed at the fag end at the instance of the petitioner in connivance with the Upazilla Nirbahi Officer the Returning Officer and the election held was on Ward basis and not village basis although it was to be held on village basis according to the finally published voters list Ext. 3. That being the position the decision reported in PLD 1965 Karachi 625 which relates to a finally published electoral roll has no manner of application in the facts of the present case. In this connection it may be pointed out that on consideration of the evidence on record the Courts below rightly found that the voter list was illegally corrected or re-arranged without authority due to which voters failed to exercise their franchise and this had affected the result of the election.
